scope.purpose: Scalability diagnosis on an isolated copy of the completed managed-gzip 100k fixture while the separate 2M build continues.
scope.isolation: Byte-identical initial database copy preserves encrypted metadata and complete bodies. Original source database hash remains unchanged. Live 2M database, binary and producer never opened or changed.
scope.runtime: Full 120-case/32-judgment harness uses frozen AOT 52bd8cf4 executable and archived supervisor. Paired AOT tool uses byte-identical frozen production library sources and the same SQLite binary.
scope.memory: Both runs enforced MemoryMax=2000000000 and MemorySwapMax=0. Kernel memory.max rounds down to page alignment. Disk filesystem; no RAM-backed database.
scope.load: Shared machine with concurrent authorized large-corpus producer; no CPU or I/O isolation. Pair timings are descriptive three-sample medians and ranges.
scope.correctness: Full harness checks content/source membership, repeated ordering, known-title relevance and 32 authored semantic judgments. It restores its 20-document overlay. Paired probe checks 54 ordered top-100 repeats, provider/group equality and unfiltered top-10 agreement with full harness; these are not exhaustive 100k ranking goldens.
scope.timing: Fresh worker open and prepare excluded from timed prepared query, immediate repeat warm. Three fresh pairs per query/filter in the separate paired probe.
scope.limit: Passing 100k latency checks does not demonstrate 2M latency or capacity. Linear posting work is an observed scalability risk, not a measured 2M failure.

sourcePartitionSql.sql: SELECT groups, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT page/8 AS posting_page, COUNT(DISTINCT group_key) AS groups FROM page_groups GROUP BY page/8) GROUP BY groups
sourcePartitionSql.conclusion: All 98 posting pages contain all five source groups, so selecting email cannot skip a candidate posting page. Exact facet bitmaps still exclude other source documents.

diagnosis.observed: Source masks reduce scored documents by roughly 84–86% for the three paired queries, while candidate posting reads remain identical and scoring posting reads retain 64–79% of unfiltered work. Per-posting authentication/decryption plus numeric scoring dominates; full-document JSON reads are zero.
minimalNextStepsNotImplemented: Reuse candidate-phase authenticated compressed posting payloads in scoring through a per-query cache bounded by bytes and entries. A 16 MiB cache holds all measured 100k query payloads; discard on query completion/cancellation. No storage or ranking change. Record hits and retained bytes when measuring.

Within an encountered 1,024-document group, reject numeric candidates whose own 128-document block bound is below the current top-100 score. Keep equality eligible to preserve recency/ID ties; thresholds only increase. This cuts unnecessary scoring but does not avoid decoding needed posting streams.

If filtered posting I/O remains dominant, allocate new source groups on 1,024-document boundaries rather than 128. Existing mixed pages require a derived-index rebuild to gain that physical pruning. This does not help unfiltered queries and is a larger migration than the two read-path changes.
diagnosis.caution: A cache avoids repeated decryption, but the candidate pass still visits all matching physical postings. Do not infer 500ms at 2M from these changes without a measured run.
